method: Weighted engineering estimate with explicit operational phase exits, not a percentage of lines written

items.acceptance: Requirements matrix; standalone subtree, owner/config/credential namespace and bridge disabled
Strict ABI, redundant reads, bounded finalization, idempotency, complete scopes and cross-scope canonicality
Pure analytic APIs with unknown values preserved, canonical event identity and prospective coverage
Real Polars export and exact-byte roundtrip after Rust verification
Continuous collectors, Redpanda, Temporal, ClickHouse, Postgres, object store and observability integrated and recovery-tested
items.earned_basis: 3/6: one point for the audited rolling collector; one for the local collection archive; one for the exact PostgreSQL DDL/transaction contract executed on PostgreSQL 18.6 in native Termux with 30 SQL checks, three actual limited-writer denials, guards and orderly restart verification. Remaining 3 points require verified-journal importer and remote storage/database/broker/workflow integration, prolonged operation, observability and joint recovery. No operational phase exit is closed.

items.acceptance: Sufficient complete measurements with eligibility, gas/tips, prices and calibrated saturation; a bounded public sample does not close this gate
Strict evidence gates, local REVM closed-state execution and supplied toxicity cases
Explicit-assumption timelocks, interest, maturity, seeded bootstrap and rival monitor
Actual workflow integration and historical price/position/execution reconstruction with certified adapters
Prospective observations compared with real outcomes during a sufficiently long Shadow window
Preparatory adapter evidence and fail-closed budget controls, no spending authority
Seeded integer resource allocation and realized-outcome admission/retraction tests
Quarantined generation, actual differential protocol testing and Foundry fuzzing
Separately configured and reviewed external signer, identities and notifications; no observer changes in this task
Concrete proposal, explicit user approval and reconciled budgeted execution
Selector/MinHash candidates, timelocks, incentives, graph evidence and maturity primitives
Actual fixture LightGBM/TreeSHAP, source binding, purged temporal holdout and deterministic environment
Reliable continuous multi-chain inventories and governed search feedback
Realized datasets, economic validation, drift/rollback and prospective improvement
Closed material review findings, retained exact-source verification, bounded public smoke test and isolated branch/PR delivery
items.earned_basis: Prior 5 points retained. +1 exact-source full delta audit and complete advisory scan; +1 verified bounded capture across three chains; +1 isolated Git delivery with preserved provenance. Remaining 2 points reserved for hermetic reproducibility and final production integration audit.

notes: An implemented primitive is not an operational phase exit.
Synthetic training/test metrics are not real investment results.
The observer remains outside the scope of all changes.

Collector source a1f6006 passed 155 Rust and 69 Python tests with clean exact build identity. The Rust count includes the subprocess helper for 13 new collector scenarios.

Three historical Ethereum windows completed across a process restart; 2 events and 8 records. The 300-block selection overlaps earlier captures and is not additive evidence. No persistent collector service, broker, database, workflow worker or economic phase exit is claimed.

Archive v2 source 169b82f passed 155 Rust and 91 Python tests, including 22 actual Rust/Polars archive regressions. Initial v1 baseline source 005ab8c lacked archive-id binding in receipts and is superseded for the delivery gate; its original evidence is preserved.

The archived three-window collection reuses the earlier 2 historical events and 8 records; zero new RPC observations. Capture/replay produced exactly one owner-bound receipt. Local archive verification does not close PostgreSQL, remote object storage, broker, workflow or economic gates.

Historical preparation stage at 6a89668: the user screenshot demonstrated bootstrap only and the contract runner awaited execution; no credit was added then. Superseded by the retained runtime audit below.

User-operated PostgreSQL 18.6 Termux contract execution was audited from the original archive: 24 manifest hashes, 30 SQL checks, three actual writer denials, wrong-database/duplicate-schema guards, byte-identical restart snapshots and final shutdown. +1 infrastructure point, now 41/100. Fixtures are synthetic and not Rust-verified journals; importer, relay and production integration remain unexecuted.
